name: VideoKen
summary: VideoKen uses AI to summarize, chapter, and index webinars, lectures, and conferences, making long-form video content easily navigable and searchable.
description: VideoKen uses AI to summarize, chapter, and index webinars, lectures, and conferences, making long-form video content easily navigable and searchable. VideoKen helps you engage better with learners by turning your videos into interactive and immersive learning experiences AI video summarization: Condenses long videos into highlight reels or concise summaries, saving viewers time. Automatic chaptering: Detects topic changes and creates clickable chapters for easy navigation. Searchable transcripts: Generates accurate transcripts and indexes key content for efficient search. Embeddable widgets: Add smart indexes and navigation tools to your video platform or website.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access Dashboard
howToUse.description: Visit VideoKen and sign up for an account. After verifying your email, log in to access the project dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start a New Project
howToUse.description: Click 'New Project' and upload your long-form video (webinar, lecture, or conference). Supported formats include MP4, MOV, and more.

howToUse.title: Configure Analysis Preferences
howToUse.description: Set options for summarization depth, chapter length, and indexing detail. You can tailor these to your audience or use case.

howToUse.title: Run AI Summarization & Chaptering
howToUse.description: Initiate the analysis. VideoKen's AI will process your video, identify key segments, summarize content, and create interactive chapters.

howToUse.title: Review Summaries & Chapters
howToUse.description: Preview the generated summaries and chapters. Manually edit titles, keywords, or timestamps for accuracy and clarity.

howToUse.title: Generate and Edit Transcript
howToUse.description: VideoKen will auto-generate a searchable transcript. Review and edit the transcript to fix names, terms, or add custom notes.

howToUse.title: Embed or Export Indexes
howToUse.description: Embed interactive chapter widgets or indexes on your website, LMS, or shareable pages. Export summaries or transcripts as needed.

howToUse.title: Monitor Engagement
howToUse.description: Use VideoKen's analytics to track how viewers interact with your chapters, indexes, and summaries.

features_fr: Résumé vidéo IA : condense les longues vidéos en extraits vidéo ou en résumés concis, ce qui permet aux spectateurs de gagner du temps.
Chapitrerage automatique : détecte les changements de sujet et crée des chapitres cliquables pour une navigation facile.
Transcriptions consultables : génère des transcriptions précises et indexe le contenu clé pour une recherche efficace.
Widgets intégrables : ajoutez des index intelligents et des outils de navigation à ton plateforme vidéo ou à ton site Web.
